content.text: That sounds brutal, and two hours of screaming would wreck anyone. Long wake-ups like this are common around 28 months. Try this tonight: keep the room dim, stay calm and close, and use few words. Don't turn the lights on or try to wake them fully. Then move bedtime 20 to 30 minutes earlier, since overtired kids tend to have rougher nights. If the screaming ever comes with a fever, vomiting, or something that seems to be hurting them, call your child's doctor's after-hours line, or 911 if it feels like an emergency.
